desc:
You are trapped in a hotel that runs forever. Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out. Please be aware of any hotel anomalies.

Guide to Play:
Memorise your surroundings. If you see an anomaly turn back. If not keep going straight. Get to level 9.

Controls [PC]:
[F] - Flashlight
[Shift] - Sprint

Controls [Console]:
[R3] - Flashlight
[L3] - Sprint

Game Supports:
PC/Desktop, Console and Mobile
